reference: If you step exactly where Mira steps, your feet stay completely dry.
sk: Ak stúpaš presne tam, kam stúpa Mira, nohy ti zostanú úplne suché.
cz: Když šlapeš přesně tam, kam šlape Mira, nohy ti zůstanou úplně suché.
acceptable: {If|When} you step {exactly|precisely|right} where Mira {steps|does}, your feet {stay|remain} {completely|totally|perfectly} dry.
Your feet {stay|remain} {completely|totally|perfectly} dry {if|when} you step {exactly|precisely|right} where Mira {steps|does}.

mistakes.text: {If|When} you step exactly where Mira steps, your feet will stay completely dry.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Ide o pravidlo, ktoré platí vždy, preto Zero Conditional: „your feet stay“, nie „will stay“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Jde o pravidlo, které platí vždy, proto Zero Conditional: „your feet stay“, ne „will stay“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This is a rule that is always true, so Zero Conditional: “your feet stay”, not “will stay”.

mistakes.text: If you will step exactly where Mira steps, your feet stay completely dry.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „if“ patrí Present Simple, nie „will“: „if you step“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „if“ patří Present Simple, ne „will“: „if you step“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “if” use Present Simple, not “will”: “if you step”.

mistakes.text: {If|When} you step exactly where Mira step, your feet stay completely dry.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Podmet „Mira“ je jedna osoba, preto v Present Simple treba „steps“ s -s.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Podmět „Mira“ je jedna osoba, proto v Present Simple je potřeba „steps“ s -s.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Mira” is one person, so Present Simple needs “steps” with -s.

mistakes.text: {If|When} you step exactly where Mira steps, your feet stays completely dry.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Feet“ je množné číslo, preto sloveso bez -s: „your feet stay“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Feet“ je množné číslo, proto sloveso bez -s: „your feet stay“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Feet” is plural, so the verb has no -s: “your feet stay”.

mistakes.text: {If|When} you step exactly where Mira steps, your legs stay completely dry.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri šliapaní ide o chodidlá, preto je prirodzenejšie „feet“ ako „legs“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Při šlapání jde o chodidla, proto je přirozenější „feet“ než „legs“.
mistakes.feedback_en: When stepping, dry “feet” is the natural word; “legs” means the whole leg.

mistakes.text: {If|When} you step exactly there where Mira steps, your feet stay completely dry.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Tam, kam“ je po anglicky len „where“, bez „there“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Where” alone is enough here; don't add “there” before it.
